_about: Editorial machine list for PinballAdvisor.com. Edit by hand. 'opdb_id' is optional: set it to pin an exact OPDB match, otherwise the refresh script matches by name + maker. 'pinside' is the slug from a pinside.com/pinball/machine/<slug> URL (optional). Prices are approximate street ranges in USD.

machines.name: Godzilla
machines.take: Huge shot variety and a great mix of goofy and deep. A modern benchmark.
pros: Tons of distinct shots and modes
Fun for beginners and experts alike
Premium building toy is a showpiece
cons: Busy layout can overwhelm new players

machines.name: Jurassic Park
machines.take: Instantly fun for guests, with enough modes to keep owners busy.
cons: Rules feel thinner after long ownership

machines.name: Foo Fighters
machines.take: Flowing ramps and a fun, cartoony presentation. Plays great even as a Pro.
cons: Theme appeal depends on the band
Fewer big toys than some rivals

machines.name: Jaws
machines.take: Smart layout with modes that tell the story well. Premium's boat mech is the highlight.
pros: Premium boat mech adds a lot
cons: Newer game, used prices still high

machines.name: John Wick
machines.take: Tight, aggressive shots that reward precise players. Can frustrate beginners.

machines.name: Metallica Remastered
machines.take: Updated version of a modern classic layout. Satisfying shots and a heavy soundtrack.
cons: Original owners may not need it

machines.name: Deadpool
machines.take: Funny, fast and approachable. Often a good used value.
cons: Humor is not family-friendly for young kids
Fewer modes than newer Stern titles

machines.name: Elton John
machines.take: Bright, polished presentation with a strong music package. Feels premium in every trim.
pros: Fun for a wide range of players

machines.name: The Godfather
machines.take: A slower, deliberate game with deep strategy. Best for players who like long-term goals.

machines.name: Halloween
machines.take: Atmospheric with great sound. Boutique build means spare parts can take longer.
cons: Parts and support can be slower

machines.name: Dune
machines.take: Distinct look and inventive shots from a newer maker. Worth playing before buying.
pros: Good value for a boutique game

machines.name: Houdini
machines.take: Friendly rules and a classic feel at a lower price. A solid first machine.

machines.name: Medieval Madness (Remake)
machines.take: New-build version of the castle game everyone loves. Huge with guests.

machines.name: Attack From Mars (Remake)
machines.take: Simple, satisfying shots and a goofy alien invasion. Very easy to love.

machines.name: Twilight Zone
machines.take: One of the deepest rule sets ever made. Older electronics need a careful pre-purchase check.

machines.name: The Addams Family
machines.take: The best-selling modern pinball game for a reason. Easy to play, easy to service.

machines.name: Monster Bash
machines.take: Spooky-fun theme with great toys. A strong pick for a game room.

machines.name: Alien
machines.take: Dark and intense with big toys. Check local support before buying a boutique import.
